archive.tome.no_description: An enchantment whose purpose is not recorded in the Archive.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and burn time. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces explosion damage and knockback. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces projectile damage. No longer obtainable; see Resilience.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Damages attackers who hit you. Chestplates only.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water beneath your feet as you walk.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once worn, this item can't be removed.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: The item loses durability more slowly. No longer obtainable.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting doesn't use up regular arrows.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better chance of fishing up treasure.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident returns to you.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Increases trident damage against mobs in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you with it.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A thrown trident summons lightning during thunderstorms.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Increases mace smash damage per block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Mace hits ignore part of the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A mace smash launches you back into the air.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: XP repairs the item. No longer obtainable.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item disappears when you die.
enchantment.archive.resilience.desc: Reduces damage from fire, explosions and projectiles, shortens burning, and reduces knockback. Chestplates only.
